title: Data Ingestion & Price Hydration Pipeline (Cache Overwrite Race, Stampede Memo, Air-Gap)

findings.issue: Wholesale cache overwrite race: price_fetcher.py:_save_json (lines 70-76) os.replaces the entire dict; concurrent callers drop each other's keys. Live miss with allow_synthetic=False caches empty candles with source: unavailable for 300s (lines 345-356).
Calibration hydration gate: price_reference.py:_hydrate_on_miss_enabled (lines 473-477) gates network calls. Gated by 900s memo interval and resolver hydration budget (lines 584-616).
History horizon cutoff: price_reference.py:572-582 returns None for days_needed > CALIBRATION_HIST_MAX_DAYS (30), retiring stale predictions without hitting network.
Air-gap verified: state_vector.py:1785-1791 and resolver.py:1133 pass allow_hydration=False. Day scoring and resolver indicators never hit network for price history.
